elements.label: Customer chat bubble
elements.text: I’d like to return my order #44433.

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Broadband vertical transient matching the regular beat stripes elsewhere in the music stem; it lands after the bubble has already appeared, so it reads as a music hit, not a UI SFX.

pattern.description: Inside the AI agent chat panel, the customer's message bubble and their circular avatar (overhanging the panel edge) appear together low in the panel and glide up into place with a long decelerating settle.
pattern.why_premium: Bubble and avatar move as one unit, the avatar breaking the panel edge adds depth, and the long ease-out settle (energy decays over ~20 frames) makes the message feel delivered rather than switched on.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo(['.msg-bubble', '.msg-avatar'], {autoAlpha: 0, y: 40, scale: 0.96}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, scale: 1, duration: 0.55, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0});
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}); for bubble and avatar: opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 3], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); transform: translateY(${(1 - p) * 40}px) scale(${0.96 + 0.04 * p}).

notes: b04/b05 are the bubble's text lines and move with b02, so they are not listed separately. camera.move is none; the negative pan_y is the bubble rising inside the panel, not a camera tilt.
